title: WebUIProof: Benchmarking WebUI Code Generators with UI-Agent Execution Harness
title_zh: WebUIProof：基于UI智能体执行框架的WebUI代码生成器基准测试

paragraphs.en: Evaluating WebUI code generation at scale is difficult: outputs may compile and look plausible yet fail under user interaction, and prior benchmarks largely rely on free-form prompts with static checks (build success, screenshots) that miss functional correctness. We introduce WebUIProof , an execution-oriented benchmark that provides structured specifications and dense, executable interaction tests for WebUI generation across two task families: general WebUIs (e.g., dashboards, game, interactive tools) and 3D interactive simulation (e.g., particle/galaxy systems, physics dynamics). WebUIProof includes a UI-agent harness that runs executable interaction tests in a headless browser using an iterative plan–act–observe loop: it locates DOM elements, performs actions, observes resulting UI/DOM changes, and checks the specified assertions. We evaluate across eight commercial LLMs and observe frequent failures on interaction-based requirements even when pages render successfully, especially on 3D simulation interfaces. Finally, we show the UI-agent harness can provide outcome-level training signals. Training compact models (e.g., Qwen2.5 14B and MIMO 7B) with RL rewards derived from executable interaction tests improves functional completion while reducing build failures. Project link: https://github.com/yunyuntsai/webuiproof-benchmark
paragraphs.zh: 大规模评估 WebUI 代码生成存在困难：生成的代码可能通过编译且看起来合理，但在用户交互时却可能失败；而以往的基准测试大多依赖自由形式的提示和静态检查（如构建成功与否、截图等），无法检测功能正确性。 我们提出了 WebUIProof——一个以执行为导向的基准测试，为 WebUI 生成提供结构化规范和密集的可执行交互测试，涵盖两类任务：通用 WebUI（例如仪表盘、游戏、交互式工具）和 3D 交互式模拟（例如粒子/星系系统、物理动态）。 WebUIProof 包含一个 UI-智能体框架，该框架在无头浏览器中运行可执行交互测试，采用“规划–执行–观察”的迭代循环：定位 DOM 元素、执行操作、观察生成的 UI/DOM 变化，并验证指定的断言。 我们对八款商用 LLM 进行了评估，发现即使页面成功渲染，基于交互的要求仍频繁失败，尤其是在 3D 模拟界面中。 最后，我们证明了该 UI-智能体框架能够提供结果层面的训练信号。 利用来自可执行交互测试的强化学习奖励来训练紧凑型模型（例如 Qwen2.5 14B 和 MIMO 7B），能够在提升功能完成度的同时减少构建失败。 项目链接：https://github.com/yunyuntsai/webuiproof-benchmark

paragraphs.en: With LLMs increasingly integrate into the software development cycles, reliable evaluation for code generation becomes critical, motivating the benchmarks for real-world GitHub issues Jimenez et al. (2023) , programming competitions Li et al. (2022) , multilingual coding tasks Zheng et al. (2023) , and interview coding problems Hendrycks et al. (2021) . Frontend code generation (WebUI generation) differs fundamentally from backend code synthesis and remains comparatively underexplored. The correctness depends not only on whether code compiles, but on what the UI renders and how it behaves under interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）日益融入软件开发周期，可靠的代码生成评估变得至关重要，这推动了针对真实 GitHub 问题（Jimenez 等人，2023）、编程竞赛（Li 等人，2022）、多语言编码任务（Zheng 等人，2023）以及面试编码问题（Hendrycks 等人，2021）的基准测试的发展。前端代码生成（WebUI 生成）与后端代码合成存在根本差异，且目前相对研究不足。其正确性不仅取决于代码能否成功编译，还取决于 UI 渲染的内容及其在交互中的行为表现。

paragraphs.en: Existing WebUI benchmarks only partially address this challenge. WebDev-Arena Zheng et al. (2024) provides a large set of web prompts, but instructions are largely free-form and evaluation relies on human preference rather than executable functional verification. WebGen-Bench Liu et al. (2024b) introduces test cases for web prompts, but many requirements stated in instructions are left unchecked, resulting in incomplete coverage of instruction-following. More broadly, many benchmarks Xiao et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Team (2024) depend on static checks such as build success, lint/type checks, or screenshots, which are insufficient to validate interactive behavior.

paragraphs.en: We introduce WebUIProof , an execution-oriented benchmark designed to measure functional, interactive correctness of WebUI code generation. WebUIProof replaces free-form prompts with structured specifications (website summary and UI element requirements) and pairs them with executable interaction tests that drive the UI agent to verify expected behavior. WebUIProof contains 219 tasks (149 general + 70 3D) paired with 3k executable interaction tests, enabling functional evaluation at much higher granularity than prompt-only benchmarks. The tasks span two families that cover standard UI workflows and richer interactive behaviors, including dashboards/games/tools and interactive 3D simulations such as physics dynamics and 3D scenes (see Fig. 1 ). Our evaluation protocol is automated and reproducible, with a fixed UI-agent execution harness that runs these tests in a headless browser by iteratively planning the next interaction, executing browser actions (e.g., click, select, type, scroll), observing DOM/visual state changes, and verifying test assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WebUIProof，这是一个以执行为导向的基准测试，旨在衡量 WebUI 代码生成的功能正确性和交互正确性。 WebUIProof 将自由形式的提示替换为结构化规范（网站摘要和 UI 元素要求），并将其与可执行的交互测试配对，这些测试会驱动 UI 智能体验证预期的行为。 WebUIProof 包含 219 个任务（149 个通用任务 + 70 个 3D 任务），并配有 3000 个可执行的交互测试，这使得功能评估的粒度远高于仅使用提示的基准测试。 这些任务涵盖两个类别，既包括标准的 UI 工作流程，也包括更丰富的交互行为，例如仪表盘/游戏/工具以及交互式 3D 模拟（如物理动力学和 3D 场景，参见图 1）。 我们的评估协议是自动化且可复现的，采用固定的 UI 智能体执行框架，通过无头浏览器运行这些测试：该框架会迭代规划下一次交互、执行浏览器操作（例如点击、选择、输入、滚动）、观察 DOM/视觉状态的变化，并验证测试断言。

paragraphs.en: While WebUIProof is primarily a benchmark contribution, the harness also provides outcome-level training signals by self-observing the rendered UI in training rollouts and deriving interactive tests from it. We therefore include VisRL (Visual-guided Reinforcement Learning), an execution-grounded RL approach that optimizes a compact model using composite rewards from build/runtime execution, visual quality, and UI-agent execution test success. In addition, we adopt several training strategies, such as multi-temperature sampling and fast-gate filtering, to improve rollout efficiency and stabilize learning under costly executable evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 WebUIProof 主要是一项基准贡献，但该测试框架还通过自我观察训练过程中渲染出的用户界面，并从中推导出交互式测试，从而提供结果层面的训练信号。 因此，我们纳入了 VisRL（视觉引导强化学习），这是一种基于执行的强化学习方法，它利用构建/运行时执行、视觉质量以及 UI-智能体执行测试的成功情况所构成的复合奖励来优化一个紧凑型模型。 此外，我们还采用了多种训练策略，例如多温度采样和快速门过滤，以提高训练过程的效率，并在成本高昂的可执行评估条件下稳定学习过程。

paragraphs.en: Prior agentic SWE systems (e.g., SWE-Agent He et al. (2024b) , SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2023) , SWE-Gym Yang et al. (2024b) , StackEval Zhang et al. (2024) ) focus on repository-level editing and bug fixing, whereas we study end-to-end WebUI generation evaluated through buildability, visual fidelity, and UI-agent-tested interactivity. FrontendBench Zhu et al. (2025) first standardizes the pipeline for frontend code generation as: (1.) LLMs receive instructions for generating code, (2.) render the code in a controlled sandbox environment, (3.) automate test scripts, and let the agent provide feedback loops. WebDev-Arena Zheng et al. (2024) is a large-scale benchmark that contains over 10k instruction prompts collected from online sources. Models are evaluated through pairwise comparisons with human votes determining preference. While valuable for capturing human preference, the instructions are loosely structured and lack automated test cases. DesignBench Xiao et al. (2025) evaluates framework-based web development (e.g., React/Vue/Angular) across generation, editing, and repair. The key difference in their setting is the evaluation signal , which scores outputs based on screenshot-level visual similarity and code modification similarity via Jaccard similarity. In particular, it does not employ a UI agent to locate DOM elements and verify behavioral assertions via scripted test cases. WebGen-Bench Liu et al. (2024b) introduces web agents that take prompt instructions to generate a frontend project with full repository, and evaluate the website with executable web tasks in the sandbox build environment In contrast, our WebUIProof provides structured specifications (website summary, functional descriptions, and required UI elements) paired with executable test cases , and evaluates generations by a UI agent that interacts with the rendered page via DOM-level element localization and action execution (click/type/navigate) to verify test assertions. Table 1 provides a detailed comparison of benchmarks for WebUI code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的智能体驱动软件工程系统（例如，SWE-Agent He et al. (2024b)、SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2023)、SWE-Gym Yang et al. (2024b) 和 StackEval Zhang et al. (2024)）主要集中在仓库级别的编辑和错误修复，而我们的研究则聚焦于端到端的 WebUI 生成，并通过可构建性、视觉保真度和 UI 智能体测试的交互性进行评估。FrontendBench Zhu et al. paragraphs.en: WebUIProof uses a fixed UI-agent execution harness to score functional correctness via executable interaction tests. For each test case, the agent follows an iterative Plan → \rightarrow Action → \rightarrow Observation loop. Specifically, it observes DOM and visual state changes, thinks and plans the interaction for the next step, executes browser actions (e.g., click/type/hover/drag/scroll, etc), and checks the test assertions. The final score aggregates test outcomes into Full/Partial/No completion based on passed assertions. This protocol is applied identically to all models and tasks during the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: WebUIProof 使用固定的 UI-智能体执行框架，通过可执行的交互测试来评估功能正确性。 对于每个测试用例，智能体遵循一个迭代的“计划 → 行动 → 观察”循环。 具体而言，它会观察 DOM 和视觉状态的变化，思考并规划下一步的交互操作，执行浏览器动作（例如点击、输入、悬停、拖拽、滚动等），并检查测试断言。 最终得分会根据通过断言的情况，将测试结果汇总为“完全完成”“部分完成”或“未完成”。 在评估过程中，该协议对所有模型和任务均一视同仁地应用。

sents.zh: 此阶段为 UI 智能体开始交互式探索提供了基本的测试用例。

paragraphs.en: Phase II: Interactive exploration and UI elements retrieval. The dynamic states, such as hidden panels, modal dialogs, pagination, and hover states, may exist but are underexplored. We therefore run the agent on the webpage with basic test cases for exploration. Specifically, the agent executes an iterative Plan → \rightarrow Action → \rightarrow Observation loop: (1.) Plan: The agent receives the test cases and plans the execution (e.g., open settings, trigger sorting, expand menus). (2.) Action: The agent makes decisions on the next action (e.g., click/type/hover/drag/scroll). (3.) Observation: The agent records state changes and extracts structured information: (i) newly discovered UI elements, (ii) updated DOM attributes, (iii) textual/UI feedback, (iv) intermediate task progress, and (v) test cases recommendation. We ask the LLMs to provide the test cases in three perspectives, including function accessibility , data display correctness , and UI design or style consistency .
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段：交互式探索与UI元素检索。 动态状态（如隐藏面板、模态对话框、分页和悬停状态）可能存在，但尚未得到充分探索。 因此，我们在网页上运行智能体，并使用基础测试用例进行探索。 具体而言，智能体执行一个迭代的“计划 → 行动 → 观察”循环：(1.) 计划：智能体接收测试用例并规划执行步骤（例如，打开设置、触发排序、展开菜单）。 (2.) 行动：智能体决定下一步操作（例如，点击/输入/悬停/拖动/滚动）。 (3.) 观察：智能体记录状态变化并提取结构化信息：(i) 新发现的UI元素，(ii) 更新的DOM属性，(iii) 文本/UI反馈，(iv) 任务中间进展，以及(v) 测试用例推荐。 我们要求大语言模型从三个角度提供测试用例，包括功能可访问性、数据展示正确性以及UI设计或风格一致性。

paragraphs.en: From these loop trajectories, we incrementally update our structured spec.: (i) element_requirement , a canonical list of required UI elements with stable identifiers and locator hints (text, role, class/id, hierarchical path); and (ii) test_cases , expanded to reflect newly discovered states.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些循环轨迹，我们逐步更新结构化规范：(i) element_requirement，即所需UI元素的规范列表，包含稳定的标识符和定位提示（文本、角色、类/ID、层级路径）；以及 (ii) test_cases，扩展以反映新发现的状态。

paragraphs.en: Phase III: Test case synthesis and post-processing. After each agent loop, we parse the interaction trajectory and extract candidate test cases from step-wise observations. Each case is formatted with: test_name, coverage_element, preconditions, procedure, and assertions . We then perform element-level coverage checking to identify UI elements that never appear in interactions or assertions. For any uncovered elements, we prompt the UI agent to generate additional test cases. Finally, we de-duplicate near-identical cases by merging variants that differ only in constants (e.g., slider values or dropdown options). The resulting instance is stored as a JSON file containing the structured specification and executable test suite. In Appendix B.3 and B.4 , we provide more detail about collection pipeline and samples for structured specification.
paragraphs.zh: 第三阶段：测试用例合成与后处理。 在每个智能体循环结束后，我们会解析交互轨迹，并从分步观察中提取候选测试用例。 每个用例的格式包括：test_name、coverage_element、preconditions、procedure 和 assertions。 接着，我们执行元素级覆盖检查，以识别从未出现在交互或断言中的 UI 元素。 对于任何未覆盖的元素，我们会提示 UI 智能体生成额外的测试用例。 最后，我们通过合并仅常数不同的变体（例如滑块值或下拉选项），来消除几乎相同的用例重复项。 最终生成的实例将存储为一个 JSON 文件，其中包含结构化规范和可执行的测试套件。 在附录 B.3 和 B.4 中，我们详细说明了结构化规范的收集流程及样本。

paragraphs.en: While WebUIProof is primarily an evaluation benchmark, the executable UI-agent harness can provide outcome-level training signals. We include VisRL (Visual-guided Reinforcement Learning) as a new training approach that optimizes a compact model using rewards computed from multiple outcomes: (i) build/runtime execution, (ii) rendered visual quality, and (iii) UI-agent interaction-test success. Concretely, given generated code c c and a task specification p p , we build and render the project and compute a composite reward r ⁡ ( c , p ) = α v ​ r v ​ ( I ⁡ ( c ) ) + α u ​ r u ​ ( s ⁡ ( c ) , 𝒯 ⁡ ( p ) ) + α m ​ r m ​ ( c ) r(c,p)=\alpha_{v}r_{v}(I(c))+\alpha_{u}r_{u}(s(c),\mathcal{T}(p))+\alpha_{m}r_{m}(c) , where r v r_{v} scores rendered screenshots, r u r_{u} is the interaction-test pass rate, and r m r_{m} is a lightweight analyzer penalty/bonus for common failure patterns. Full PPO details are provided in Appendix C.2 C.3 , C.4 .

paragraphs.en: Design Insight. We observe that single-signal rewards are insufficient in WebUI generation. Optimizing interaction tests only tends to produce minimal but functional UIs, while optimizing visual scores only improves visual appearance quality without guaranteeing correct behavior. Thus, combining build/runtime, visual, and interaction signals yields the most balanced improvements across functionality and UI appearance, We provide comprehensive studies on reward decomposition and weight sensitivity in Appendix D.2 , D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 设计洞察。 我们观察到，单一信号奖励在 WebUI 生成中是不足的。 仅优化交互测试往往只能产生功能勉强可用但极其简陋的 UI，而仅优化视觉评分则只会提升外观质量，却无法确保行为正确。 因此，结合构建/运行时、视觉和交互信号，可以在功能性和 UI 外观之间实现最均衡的改进。我们在附录 D.2 和 D.3 中提供了关于奖励分解和权重敏感性的全面研究。

paragraphs.en: Training Stability. Because rewards are only observed after build/render/test, we adopt two lightweight strategies to stabilize and reduce rollout cost: multi-temperature sampling to increase candidate diversity under a fixed best-of- N N budget, and fast-gate filtering to skip obviously invalid generations before expensive execution. Ablations in Sec. 5.3 show both components matter for accuracy and build failure reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 训练稳定性。 由于奖励仅在构建/渲染/测试之后才能观察到，我们采用两种轻量级策略来稳定训练并降低展开成本：多温度采样，用于在固定的最佳 N 次采样预算下提升候选结果的多样性；以及快速门过滤，用于在昂贵执行之前跳过明显无效的生成结果。 第 5.3 节中的消融实验表明，这两个组件对准确性和减少构建失败都至关重要。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate eight state-of-the-art LLMs spanning different architectures, scales, and training paradigms. Claude Sonnet 4 Anthropic (2025) and Gemini 2.5 Pro DeepMind (2025) represent strong closed-source reasoning-oriented models with multimodal capabilities. Qwen 3 Coder 480B Instruct 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct Alibaba Cloud (2025) and Llama 4 Maverick Meta (2025) / Llama 3 405B Meta (2024) are open-source instruction-tuned models optimized for code synthesis and general reasoning. paragraphs.en: We evaluate functional correctness using a fixed UI-agent execution harness implemented with Playwright webdriver and a vision-language model ( Qwen2.5 VL 72B ) as the evaluator. The evaluator runs in a headless browser with a 1280 × \times 800 viewport, a per-task step budget of 15, and supports the actions {click, type, select, scroll, drag, hover, wait}. Each task is scored by executing its test suite and aggregating outcomes into Full/Partial/No completion. We keep this evaluator frozen and identical across all models and methods. Details of the execution environment, prompts, and failure handling are provided in Appendix A . We additionally validate evaluator robustness via expanded human–agent agreement (N=100 across multiple model families) and step-budget sensitivity analysis (5/10/15 steps) with failure-mode attribution (see Sec. 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个基于 Playwright webdriver 实现的固定 UI-智能体执行框架，以及一个视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5 VL 72B）作为评估器，来评估功能正确性。 该评估器在无头浏览器中运行，视口尺寸为 1280 × 800，每个任务的步骤预算为 15，并支持以下操作：{点击、输入、选择、滚动、拖动、悬停、等待}。 每个任务通过执行其测试套件并汇总结果（完全完成/部分完成/未完成）进行评分。 我们在所有模型和方法中均保持该评估器固定不变且完全一致。 执行环境、提示词和故障处理的相关细节见附录 A。 此外，我们还通过扩展性的人机智能体一致性测试（N=100，涵盖多个模型系列）以及步骤预算敏感性分析（5/10/15 步），并结合故障模式归因（参见第 5.1 节），来验证评估器的稳健性。

sents.en: We evaluate functional correctness using a fixed UI-agent execution harness implemented with Playwright webdriver and a vision-language model ( Qwen2.5 VL 72B ) as the evaluator.
sents.zh: 我们使用一个基于 Playwright webdriver 实现的固定 UI-智能体执行框架，以及一个视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5 VL 72B）作为评估器，来评估功能正确性。

sents.en: The evaluator runs in a headless browser with a 1280 × \times 800 viewport, a per-task step budget of 15, and supports the actions {click, type, select, scroll, drag, hover, wait}.
sents.zh: 该评估器在无头浏览器中运行，视口尺寸为 1280 × 800，每个任务的步骤预算为 15，并支持以下操作：{点击、输入、选择、滚动、拖动、悬停、等待}。

sents.en: Each task is scored by executing its test suite and aggregating outcomes into Full/Partial/No completion.
sents.zh: 每个任务通过执行其测试套件并汇总结果（完全完成/部分完成/未完成）进行评分。

sents.en: We keep this evaluator frozen and identical across all models and methods.
sents.zh: 我们在所有模型和方法中均保持该评估器固定不变且完全一致。

sents.en: Details of the execution environment, prompts, and failure handling are provided in Appendix A .
sents.zh: 执行环境、提示词和故障处理的相关细节见附录 A。

sents.en: We additionally validate evaluator robustness via expanded human–agent agreement (N=100 across multiple model families) and step-budget sensitivity analysis (5/10/15 steps) with failure-mode attribution (see Sec. 5.1 ).
sents.zh: 此外，我们还通过扩展性的人机智能体一致性测试（N=100，涵盖多个模型系列）以及步骤预算敏感性分析（5/10/15 步），并结合故障模式归因（参见第 5.1 节），来验证评估器的稳健性。

paragraphs.en: Training Details of VisRL. We use Qwen 2.5 14B Instruct Alibaba Cloud and Team (2024) as our base model. We first launch the SFT training to establish a cold-start checkpoint. After that, we launch the PPO learning with LoRA adapters ( r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 for general WebUI task), batch size 24, learning rate 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7} , and vLLM for off-policy generation with periodic adapter reloads. We use 4 H100-80 GB NVIDIA GPUs for training. We compare VisRL with two training variant, including pure SFT and PPO with vision agent. The baseline, PPO with vision agent, leverages the agent to score the WebUI screenshot with vision rubric (see Appendix C.7 ). We provide implementation details, including training hyperparameters, hardware resources, system configuration, and training infrastructure ( see Appendix C.1 ). In Appendix D.1 , we show the training curve analysis.

paragraphs.en: Training Data. For general WebUI task, we leverage the 6000 training set from webgen-bench Liu et al. (2024b) to do the SFT and PPO training. We de-duplicate the training data and also avoid using data that requires a login page first to facilitate our training process. For the 3D simulation task, we construct our own Three.js training dataset by scraping the official threejs.org examples. Using the files.json index, we crawl each demo and parse its HTML to extract metadata (title, description, tags), which we convert into instruction prompts. The resulting dataset covers a wide range of real-world Three.js patterns (e.g., animation, interactive controls, external assets, visual effects) and contains 1600+ prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据。对于通用的 WebUI 任务，我们利用 webgen-bench 中 Liu 等人（2024b）提供的 6000 条训练数据来进行 SFT 和 PPO 训练。我们对训练数据进行了去重处理，同时避免使用需要先登录页面的数据，以简化我们的训练流程。对于 3D 模拟任务，我们通过抓取 threejs.org 官方网站上的示例，构建了自己的 Three.js 训练数据集。借助 files.json 索引文件，我们爬取了每个演示案例，并解析其 HTML 以提取元数据（标题、描述、标签），随后将其转换为指令提示词。最终形成的数据集涵盖了广泛的实际 Three.js 应用场景（例如动画、交互式控件、外部资源、视觉效果），并包含超过 1600 条提示词。

paragraphs.en: Since WebUIProof relies on a UI-agent execution harness to run interaction tests, we quantify evaluator reliability by reporting (i) human-agent agreement on the Full / Partial / No labels across multiple model families, and (ii) sensitivity to the evaluator step budget with failure attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 WebUIProof 依赖 UI-智能体执行框架来运行交互测试，我们通过以下方式量化评估器的可靠性：(i) 报告人类与智能体在多个模型系列中对“完整/部分/无”标签的一致性；以及 (ii) 分析评估器步骤预算变化时的敏感度及故障归因。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Human–agent agreement across model families. We annotate N = 100 N=100 General WebUI samples and compare the UI agent’s labels against human judgments for three model families (Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and self-trained Qwen 2.5 14B with VisRL). Table 4 reports agreement rates and confusion matrices. Overall agreement is consistently above ∼ \sim 80%, suggesting that the evaluator provides a reasonably stable signal across different generation styles.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 不同模型家族中人类与智能体的一致性。 我们对 N = 100 N=100 个 General WebUI 样本进行了标注，并将 UI 智能体的标签与三个模型家族（Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro 以及通过 VisRL 自训练的 Qwen 2.5 14B）的人类判断进行了比较。 表 4 报告了一致性率和混淆矩阵。 整体一致性持续高于 ∼ \sim 80%，表明评估器在不同生成风格下能够提供相对稳定的一致性信号。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Step budget sensitivity and failure attribution. Evaluator errors can arise from limited interaction budget or brittle element grounding. To characterize this, we vary the per-task step budget (5/10/15) on the same N = 100 N=100 samples and attribute disagreements to concrete failure modes: timeout/step-limit, interaction failure (action executed but UI does not respond as expected), and element-locator failure (target cannot be grounded). Table 5 shows agreement increases with larger budgets while timeouts decrease, indicating that a meaningful portion of disagreement is due to resource/grounding limitations rather than systematic scoring bias.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 步骤预算敏感性与故障归因。 评估器错误可能源于有限的交互预算或脆弱的元素定位机制。 为描述这一现象，我们在相同的 N = 100 N=100 个样本上调整每个任务的步骤预算（5/10/15），并将分歧归因于具体的故障模式：超时/步骤限制、交互失败（动作已执行但用户界面未如预期响应）以及元素定位器故障（无法定位目标元素）。 表 5 显示，随着预算增加，一致性提高而超时情况减少，这表明分歧中相当一部分源于资源或定位限制，而非系统性的评分偏差。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Sensitivity to instruction complexity. To quantify how functional requirements scale with instruction difficulty, we define an instruction complexity index (ICI) that captures more than prompt length. ICI aggregates two factors, including Size S S (number of required elements and tests), Interactivity I I (interaction verbs/actions): ICI = 0.5 ​ S + 0.5 ​ I \text{ICI}=0.5S+0.5I . While increasing the step, we increment the instruction with more requirements. The generation of each step is built sequentially; that is, the model will generate the code for the current step based on the code generated from prior steps. In Fig 5 (left side subgraph), we show the commercial models’ performance. When increasing the step from 1 to 9, the ICI score increases up to 68 (red dotted line), and the accuracy of the three frontier models gradually drops. On the right side subgraph, we show the accuracy of our self-trained model, including baseline SFT and VisRL (PPO with UI agent). The trend is similar to the frontier models.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 对指令复杂度的敏感度。 为了量化功能需求如何随指令难度变化，我们定义了一个指令复杂度指数（ICI），该指数不仅考虑提示词的长度。 ICI 综合了两个因素，包括规模 S（所需元素和测试的数量）以及交互性 I（交互动词/动作）：ICI = 0.5S + 0.5I。 随着步骤的增加，我们会通过添加更多需求来扩展指令。 每个步骤的生成都是顺序进行的；也就是说，模型将基于先前步骤生成的代码来生成当前步骤的代码。 在图 5（左侧子图）中，我们展示了商业模型的性能。 当步骤从 1 增加到 9 时，ICI 分数最高可达 68（红色虚线），而三种前沿模型的准确率则逐渐下降。 在右侧子图中，我们展示了自训练模型的准确率，包括基线 SFT 和 VisRL（使用 UI 智能体的 PPO）。 其趋势与前沿模型相似。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Test coverage rate of WebUIProof. We assess benchmark quality using TCR, the fraction of required UI elements exercised by the test suite. For each task, a UI element is counted as covered if it is referenced by any test case as an interaction target or assertion. We compare TCR between free-form instruction prompts collected from WebGen-Bench Liu et al. (2024b) and stuctured specs. from WebUIProof (ours). We report two metrics: model accuracy and build failure rate. High TCR paired with low accuracy indicates that the instruction provides dense, informative tests that remain challenging. paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet WebUIProof 的测试覆盖率。我们使用 TCR（测试覆盖比率）来评估基准的质量，即测试套件所触发的必要 UI 元素的比例。对于每个任务，如果某个 UI 元素被任何测试用例用作交互目标或断言，则被视为已覆盖。我们将 WebGen-Bench 中 Liu 等人（2024b）收集的自由格式指令提示与 WebUIProof（我们的方法）的结构化规范之间的 TCR 进行了比较。我们报告了两个指标：模型准确率和构建失败率。高 TCR 但准确率较低，表明该指令提供了密集且信息丰富的测试，但这些测试仍然具有挑战性。图 5 显示，TCR 从自由格式下的 30.71% 提升到了结构化规范下的 97.23%；由此导致的准确率下降表明 WebUIProof 更具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce WebUIProof , an execution-oriented benchmark for WebUI code generation that pairs structured specifications with executable interaction tests spanning general WebUIs and 3D simulation interfaces. WebUIProof includes a reproducible UI-agent harness for automated evaluation, enabling functional verification beyond build success or static visual checks. Using this protocol, we benchmark eight frontier models and find that interactive WebUI generation remains challenging in both domains, with substantial headroom on 3D tasks. We also show that the same harness can provide outcome-level training signals by including VisRL , an execution-grounded RL appraoch that optimizes compact models with composite rewards from build/runtime execution, rendered visual quality, and UI-agent test success. VisRL improves both functional completion and reliability compared to SFT and vision-only baselines. Our ablation suggests that performance remains bottlenecked by complex instruction and multi-step requirements, motivating future work on reward assignment, richer executable signals, and robust evaluation agents for dynamic 3D WebUI. Overall, our work shed light on the importance of outcome-grounded, executable evaluation and training signals for reliable code generation beyond static correctness and visual-only metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WebUIProof，这是一个面向执行导向的 WebUI 代码生成基准测试，它将结构化规范与可执行的交互测试相结合，涵盖通用 WebUI 和 3D 模拟界面。 WebUIProof 包含一个可复现的 UI-智能体测试框架，用于自动化评估，从而实现超越构建成功与否或静态视觉检查的功能验证。 通过该协议，我们对八款前沿模型进行了基准测试，发现交互式 WebUI 生成在这两个领域仍存在挑战，尤其是在 3D 任务方面仍有较大提升空间。 我们还证明，同一测试框架可以通过引入 VisRL 提供结果层面的训练信号；VisRL 是一种基于执行的强化学习方法，利用构建/运行时执行、渲染视觉质量和 UI-智能体测试成功等复合奖励来优化紧凑型模型。 与 SFT 和仅基于视觉的基线方法相比，VisRL 在功能完整性和可靠性方面均有提升。 我们的消融分析表明，性能瓶颈仍源于复杂指令和多步骤需求，这为未来在奖励分配、更丰富的可执行信号以及面向动态 3D WebUI 的稳健评估智能体方面的研究提供了方向。 总体而言，我们的工作揭示了基于结果的可执行评估与训练信号对于实现超越静态正确性和纯视觉指标的可信代码生成所具有的重要性。

paragraphs.en: The agent operates through a number of iteration steps, where each step follows a thinking loop: (1.) Selenium takes UI screenshots and parses the DOM interactive web elements via executable JavaScript code snippets. (2.) LLMs reason from the visual information in the UI screenshots and provide "Thought" and "Action" responses. The actions are predefined under an action space (e.g., click/type/scroll/select/hover…) (see Table 7 ). LLMs will choose one action for each step, and the action is executed by Selenium. The UI state will update for the next iteration, and at the final step, we ask LLMs to assess task completion, including three answer options: "FULL", "NO", and "PARTIAL" completion. In our experiment, we set the maximum iteration step as 15. (Mentioned in Sec. 3 .1 as well)
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过多个迭代步骤运行，每个步骤都遵循一个思考循环：（1）Selenium 截取用户界面截图，并通过可执行的 JavaScript 代码片段解析 DOM 中的交互式网页元素。 （2）大语言模型根据用户界面截图中的视觉信息进行推理，并提供“思考”和“操作”响应。 这些操作在操作空间中预先定义（例如：点击/输入/滚动/选择/悬停……）（参见表 7）。 大语言模型会在每个步骤中选择一个操作，该操作由 Selenium 执行。 用户界面状态会更新以进入下一次迭代，在最后一步，我们会要求大语言模型评估任务是否完成，包括三个答案选项：“完全”、“未完成”和“部分”完成。 在我们的实验中，我们将最大迭代步骤设为 15。 （在第 3.1 节中也有提及）

paragraphs.en: To ensure reproducibility and make our evaluation pipeline fully auditable, we disclose the exact system prompts used for our two task families: (i) General WebUI generation and (ii) 3D WebUI simulation (As shown in Fig. 8 and 9 ). These two settings require different code formats and runtime assumptions , and we therefore use task-specific prompts to standardize model outputs. For General WebUI tasks (Fig. 8 ), models are instructed to generate a single-file React/TypeScript component compatible with a Next.js (pages router) scaffold, with strict output constraints (default export only, no surrounding text) and styling constraints (Tailwind classes without arbitrary values). In contrast, 3D simulation tasks (Fig. 9 ) require a self-contained HTML document that renders an interactive Three.js scene. The prompt fixes the Three.js version and enforces verified CDN imports to avoid dependency drift, and additionally emphasizes runtime robustness (error handling, interactivity checks) and output formatting (start from <!DOCTYPE html> and return HTML only). By explicitly specifying the target artifact ( pages/index.tsx React code vs. standalone HTML), these prompts reduce formatting variance across models and ensure that downstream building, rendering, and UI-agent testing are applied consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保可重复性并使我们的评估流程完全具备审计能力，我们公开了用于两个任务系列的精确系统提示：(i) 通用 WebUI 生成和 (ii) 3D WebUI 模拟（如第 8 和第 9 图所示）。 这两种设置需要不同的代码格式和运行时假设，因此我们使用任务特定的提示来标准化模型输出。 对于通用 WebUI 任务（第 8 图），模型被指示生成一个与 Next.js（页面路由器）脚手架兼容的单文件 React/TypeScript 组件，并遵循严格的输出约束（仅默认导出，无外围文本）和样式约束（使用 Tailwind 类且不含任意值）。 相比之下，3D 模拟任务（第 9 图）需要一个自包含的 HTML 文档，用于渲染交互式 Three.js 场景。 该提示固定了 Three.js 版本并强制使用经过验证的 CDN 导入以避免依赖漂移，同时还强调了运行时的健壮性（错误处理、交互性检查）和输出格式（从 <!DOCTYPE html> 开始且仅返回 HTML）。 通过明确指定目标产物（pages/index.tsx React 代码与独立 HTML），这些提示减少了不同模型之间的格式差异，并确保下游的构建、渲染和 UI 智能体测试能够一致执行。

paragraphs.en: For each task, we categorize the outcome into four mutually exclusive cases: (i) Full Success , (ii) Partial Success , (iii) No Success , and (iv) Build Failure .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们将结果分为四种互斥的情况：(i) 完全成功，(ii) 部分成功，(iii) 未成功，以及 (iv) 构建失败。

paragraphs.en: Build Failure covers build-time or launch-time failures (e.g., compilation errors, runtime crashes, or timeouts) where the generated project cannot be executed for UI-agent testing. Importantly, we average Full/Partial/No Success over all tasks by treating build failure with no credit. As a result, the corresponding rates satisfy Full + Partial + No Success + Build failure ≈ 100 % \text{Full}+\text{Partial}+\text{No Success}+\text{Build failure}\approx 100\% .
paragraphs.zh: 构建失败涵盖构建时或启动时的故障（例如，编译错误、运行时崩溃或超时），此时生成的项目无法执行以进行 UI 智能体测试。 重要的是，我们将完整/部分/无成功在所有任务中取平均值，同时将构建失败视为零分处理。 因此，相应的比率满足：完整 + 部分 + 无成功 + 构建失败 ≈ 100% \text{Full}+\text{Partial}+\text{No Success}+\text{Build failure}\approx 100\%。

paragraphs.en: The 3D simulation test instruction dataset features advanced Three.js-based interactive visualizations and simulations derived from Three.js opensource website examples and community contributions. This specialized collection contains 70 sophisticated 3D programming challenges that span astronomical simulations (particle galaxy formations with spiral arms, black hole visualizations with event horizon effects), geometric animations (tesseract rotations with collision detection, merry-go-round mechanics with adjustable parameters), physics-based demonstrations (bouncing ball dynamics within complex 3D shapes), and interactive exploration systems that allow users to navigate through immersive 3D environments using JavaScript controls. Each instruction demands implementation of complex mathematical concepts including 3D transformations, particle systems, collision detection algorithms, and real-time rendering optimizations, while maintaining smooth 60fps performance and responsive user interaction capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 该三维模拟测试指令数据集包含基于 Three.js 的交互式可视化与模拟，这些内容源自 Three.js 开源网站的示例及社区贡献。 这一专业合集包含 70 个复杂的三维编程挑战，涵盖天文模拟（带螺旋臂的粒子星系形成、具有事件视界效应的黑洞可视化）、几何动画（带碰撞检测的四维超立方体旋转、参数可调的旋转木马机制）、基于物理的演示（复杂三维形状内的弹跳球动力学），以及允许用户通过 JavaScript 控件在沉浸式三维环境中导航的交互式探索系统。 每条指令都要求实现复杂的数学概念，包括三维变换、粒子系统、碰撞检测算法和实时渲染优化，同时需保持流畅的每秒 60 帧性能与响应的用户交互能力。

sents.zh: 这一专业合集包含 70 个复杂的三维编程挑战，涵盖天文模拟（带螺旋臂的粒子星系形成、具有事件视界效应的黑洞可视化）、几何动画（带碰撞检测的四维超立方体旋转、参数可调的旋转木马机制）、基于物理的演示（复杂三维形状内的弹跳球动力学），以及允许用户通过 JavaScript 控件在沉浸式三维环境中导航的交互式探索系统。

sents.en: Each instruction demands implementation of complex mathematical concepts including 3D transformations, particle systems, collision detection algorithms, and real-time rendering optimizations, while maintaining smooth 60fps performance and responsive user interaction capabilities.
sents.zh: 每条指令都要求实现复杂的数学概念，包括三维变换、粒子系统、碰撞检测算法和实时渲染优化，同时需保持流畅的每秒 60 帧性能与响应的用户交互能力。

paragraphs.en: The tasks require understanding of WebGL fundamentals, Three.js scene graph management, camera controls, lighting systems, material properties, and animation loops, with many instructions specifically requesting single HTML file implementations that demonstrate advanced computer graphics concepts through browser-based 3D experiences. paragraphs.en: We finetune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a curated dataset of 6000 high-quality webUI generation samples. We use the 6k training set from WebGen-Bench as our seed instruction and generate code snippets using DeepSeek-R1. Our model is trained with distributed training across 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs (80 GB each) with full parameter tuning. To handle long code sequences, we employ dynamic RoPE scaling with a factor of 2.0, extend the context window to 65536 tokens, and apply a chunking strategy that segments sequences into 1792-token windows with 128-token overlap. The model is trained under 8 epochs with a learning rate 8 × 10 − 6 8\times 10^{-6} and an effective batch size of 256 (per-device batch size of 1 with 64 gradient accumulation steps across 4 GPUs). Other training hyperparameters, hardware configuration are shown in Table 8 . We apply chat template formatting where only assistant responses are supervised (prompt tokens masked with -100). Training converges in approximately 8 hours after eight training epochs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个经过筛选的数据集上对 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 进行了微调，该数据集包含 6000 个高质量的 webUI 生成样本。 我们将 WebGen-Bench 提供的 6k 训练集用作初始指令，并使用 DeepSeek-R1 生成代码片段。 我们的模型通过分布式训练在 4 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU（每块 80 GB）上进行训练，并采用全参数调整方式。 为处理长代码序列，我们采用了动态 RoPE 缩放（缩放因子为 2.0），将上下文窗口扩展至 65536 个 token，并应用了一种分块策略，将序列分割为 1792 token 的窗口，每个窗口之间重叠 128 个 token。 模型在 8 个训练周期内进行训练，学习率为 8 × 10⁻⁶，有效批量大小为 256（每设备批量大小为 1，通过 4 块 GPU 进行 64 次梯度累积）。 其他训练超参数和硬件配置见表 8。 我们应用了聊天模板格式，其中仅对助手回复进行监督（提示 token 使用 -100 掩码）。 经过八个训练周期后，训练在大约 8 小时内收敛。

paragraphs.en: After using SFT to train a cold-starting model, we start to use PPO with a hybrid on/off-policy approach that leverages vLLM for fast generation while maintaining near-on-policy learning through frequent adapter reloading. Unlike prior SFT training, which distributes the model across 4 GPUs, we allocate 4 H100 GPUs: GPU-0 fully loads the model to serve as the vLLM inference server (generating code snippets), and other three GPUs run distributed PPO optimization via DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 for policy learning. Due to the memory constraint, we apply LoRA adapters to all attention and MLP projection layers for PPO tuning, where we set the rank-8 and α \alpha -16 for general WebUI task. Since the 3D Simulation requires a higher learning capacity, we further set a larger rank-128 with a ​ l ​ p ​ h ​ a alpha -256 for the 3D simulation task. To make the model loaded on GPU-0 synchronize with the on-policy model, we reload the latest adapter every training step to minimize off-policy lag. Training proceeds for 100 steps with a conservative learning rate of 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7} , batch size is 8 per device (effective batch of 24 across 3 GPUs). In Fig. 15 , we illustrate the training infrastructure of VisRL. In addition, we show the detailed training hyperparameters of VisRL in Table 9 . Training completes in approximately 24-48 hours with checkpoints saved every step for reproducibility. In the later Sec. D.1 , we provide the training curve analysis for different PPO strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用 SFT 训练一个冷启动模型之后，我们开始采用一种混合 on/off-policy 的 PPO 方法。该方法利用 vLLM 实现快速生成，同时通过频繁重新加载适配器来保持接近 on-policy 的学习效果。与先前将模型分布在 4 块 GPU 上的 SFT 训练不同，我们分配了 4 块 H100 GPU：GPU-0 完全加载模型，用作 vLLM 推理服务器（用于生成代码片段），其余三块 GPU 则通过 DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 运行分布式 PPO 优化，以进行策略学习。由于内存限制，我们在所有注意力层和 MLP 投影层上应用了 LoRA 适配器来进行 PPO 调优；对于通用的 WebUI 任务，我们将 rank 设为 8，α \alpha 设为 -16。由于 3D 模拟需要更高的学习能力，我们进一步将 rank 设为更大的 128，并将 ​ l ​ p ​ h ​ a alpha 设为 -256。为了使加载在 GPU-0 上的模型与 on-policy 模型保持同步，我们在每个训练步骤中都会重新加载最新的适配器，以最小化 off-policy 的滞后。训练共进行 100 步，采用保守的学习率 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7}，每块设备的批量大小为 8（三块 GPU 的有效批量为 24）。图 15 展示了 VisRL 的训练基础设施。此外，我们在表 9 中列出了 VisRL 的详细训练超参数。整个训练过程大约需要 24-48 小时完成，并且为了便于复现，每个步骤都会保存检查点。在后续的 D.1 节中，我们将对不同 PPO 策略的训练曲线进行分析。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 16 shows that incorporating the UI agent substantially improves PPO training stability and efficiency. In Fig. 16 a, we show the training curve for PPO learning w/ vision agent only. The average reward increases only gradually and remains noisy; the vision score fluctuates with no clear upward trend, and the invalid action rate stays relatively high throughout training. In contrast, VisRL adopts the UI agent (Fig. 16 b), the reward rises sharply in the early phase and maintains a consistently higher level. This improvement is accompanied by a strong increase in vision score and a steady reduction in invalid actions, indicating that agent-based interaction feedback provides a cleaner learning signal and guides the policy toward more executable, UI-consistent code.

paragraphs.en: To better understand the effectiveness of each reward component, we present a reward decomposition analysis. Figure 17 shows a radar plot analysis comparing reward components across different training strategies for both General WebUI and 3D WebUI Simulation tasks. We evaluate five metrics: Build Success (compilation rate), Average Vision Score (aesthetic quality from GPT-4o-mini), UI Agent Test Full Success (all proposed interactions succeed), UI Agent Test Half Success (≥50% interactions succeed). The analysis compares: (1) SFT baseline without RL ( gray ), (2) PPO with analyzer-only reward ( r m r_{m} , orange ), (3) PPO with vision-only reward ( r v r_{v} , blue ), (4) PPO with UI-agent-only reward ( r u r_{u} , green ), and (5) VisRL with the full composite reward ( r m + r v + r u r_{m}+r_{v}+r_{u} , red ). Results demonstrate that single-component rewards lead to unbalanced optimization: vision-only PPO achieves high aesthetic scores but poor functional correctness, UI-agent-only PPO maximizes interaction success but produces visually simplistic interfaces, and analyzer-only PPO maintains build success but lacks both visual appeal and interactivity. In contrast, VisRL with the composite reward ( α v = 0.6 , α u = 0.3 , α m = 0.1 \alpha_{v}=0.6,\alpha_{u}=0.3,\alpha_{m}=0.1 ) achieves the most balanced performance, excelling across all dimensions simultaneously. Notably, for 3D simulation tasks, the balanced reward maintains high build success (>0.9) while significantly improving both vision scores and UI agent test success rates compared to single-component baselines, validating the necessity of multi-component reward design for holistic web UI generation quality.

paragraphs.en: To investigate the build failure reason, we categorize build-time errors into four primary types based on failure patterns observed during Next.js execution logs. Module Not Found errors occur when Webpack cannot resolve imported packages (e.g., @heroicons/react , react-icons , or react-dnd ), typically due to missing installations, incorrect import paths, or renamed files. Syntax errors arise when the TypeScript/JavaScript parser encounters malformed code (e.g., missing braces, parentheses, or template literal errors), preventing the compilation stage from completing. Default Export errors (happen when a Next.js page compiles but fails during the static generation stage because some certain file do not contain a valid default React component export (e.g., pages/modelOutputPage.tsx ). Finally, Reference errors occur at runtime during server-side rendering or static generation, often due to accessing variables before initialization or circular imports. In Table 30 , we show the four dominant failure counts on eight models, providing insight into the generation ability of each model.
paragraphs.zh: 为了调查构建失败的原因，我们根据 Next.js 执行日志中观察到的失败模式，将构建时的错误分为四大类。 当 Webpack 无法解析导入的包（例如 @heroicons/react、react-icons 或 react-dnd）时，就会发生“模块未找到”错误，这通常是由于缺少安装、导入路径不正确或文件名被重命名所致。 当 TypeScript/JavaScript 解析器遇到格式错误的代码（例如缺少大括号、括号或模板字符串错误）时，就会引发语法错误，导致编译阶段无法完成。 默认导出错误发生在 Next.js 页面成功编译但在静态生成阶段失败的情况，原因是一些文件未包含有效的默认 React 组件导出（例如 pages/modelOutputPage.tsx）。 最后，“引用”错误发生在服务器端渲染或静态生成的运行时阶段，通常是由于在变量初始化前访问该变量或存在循环导入所致。 在表 30 中，我们展示了八种模型上四种主要失败类型的数量，从而揭示了每种模型的生成能力。
